subject: CONTRACT specialized graphics compile (render consumer), ACK render 19:12 design
body:
Claude lowering (Opus) replaces Codex lowering. Header mali_graphics_compiler.h sha 0ccf113b (== built lib ea4454b7 source). Render plan ACK with these exact rules:
CALL: int tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_specialized(vs,vn,fs,fn, vc,nc, fc,nf, &vso,&fso,&pair2,&gplan, err,errn) or _specialized_rt(...,rt 0..7,...). _specialized_tile_rt only under TEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT. Include mali_compute_compiler.h for struct tegu_mali_specialization {uint32 id,size; uint8 data[8]} (16B). TeguAIRGraphicsSpecConstant is layout-identical: pass (const struct tegu_mali_specialization*)spec.vertex_constants,spec.vertex_count and fragment_constants,fragment_count; add _Static_assert(sizeof==16 && offsetof(data)==8) in render. Counts <=64 each; NULL/0 legal.
SEMANTICS: tables are per-stage SpecId namespaces, validated against each module BEFORE Mesa (unknown id, dup, size!=declared, bool must be size4 VkBool32 -> rc2, message 'Vertex|Fragment specialization ID n: ...'). Unprovided IDs keep module defaults; tables equal to defaults give byte-identical legacy code+plan. Changed constants prune dead resources, so gplan.bindings reflects ONLY live post-specialization set0 bindings.
OUTPUTS: all outputs (vso,fso,pair2,gplan) must be zeroed on entry, disjoint from inputs/tables/err; rc1 = span/alias/non-empty (nothing written but err may be set); rc!=0 => code freed, pair/plan zero. Success: caller owns vso.code/fso.code, free with tegu_mali_graphics_free. gplan.reserved = rt+1 for _rt. Tables are borrowed only during call.
BINDING: buffers table1[binding], textures/input-attachments table1[binding], samplers table2[binding]; combined => both. Validate gplan against GenericPlan with existing tegu_generic_compile_matches, and additionally each spec.bindings[] row's binding must exist in gplan if gplan lists it (dead binding may be absent: do not bind/require it).
CACHE (HAZARD): pipeline_cache_frontend.inc tegu_pc_mali_pair keys only entry/rt/sizes/module bytes. Do NOT route a specialized compile through an existing TEGU_PC_MALI_GENERIC* entry: that would return the default-specialization code for a nondefault table. Needs a new entry id whose key adds nc,nf and both full tables (16B records) — that file is unowned => root, or bypass the persistent cache. In-memory variant key: both module bytes, both tables, rt, tile mode (specialization_bytes[512] alone is ambiguous when VS/FS share a SpecId).
VERTEX IDENTITY: specialized entries keep the current fold (base_instance:=0, VertexIndex = hw id). Keep your -13 refusal. I am now implementing an additive draw-parameter entry (FAU sysval for vertex base/base instance) and will post its exact contract + tests before you use it. Also adding pre-Mesa refusal for BaseVertex/first_vertex-class sysvals that currently reach Bifrost 'Unhandled intrinsic' assert(0).
